[P2] Plan the canonical enum-name compatibility break

Declaring these names first changes the deprecated members' public `.name` values and their names during enum iteration, including for applications that never enable async semantics. Existing consumers that compare or serialize those names receive different identifiers. The description acknowledges this behavior but identifies no breaking-release plan, while core remains on 3.1.0. This breaks CONTRIBUTING rule 1.3, which requires existing capabilities to follow breaking-change release rules. Please return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6) and agree on compatible aliasing or an explicit breaking-release plan.
